counting: One row per (seed, seat, round); identical duplicates removed, conflicts rejected. R8-R14 endpoint growth spans six rounds. Counts are real seats observed at that pre-start bell. Paired cohort means seats alive entering R14, observed at both R8 and R14; a lone winner in a lobby ending earlier is absent, not zero. Zero denominators and absent rounds yield null; zero-start seats stay in raw paired rows but are excluded from individual-growth medians.

splash.scope: All rounds; hard:varied only; committed-line seats and their food purchases excluded. Unique offers are counted by the harness per seat and unit iid. Grouping uses the final build's highest declared tribe weights; ties retain every primary tribe. Known neutral builds count as off-build; missing strategy definitions are separate.
